headline: GTA 6 countdown: 2 days to go
title: GTA 6 Countdown 2 Days Left | Two delays | Vice City Is Back
video_script: Only 2 days until GTA 6. After two delays, GTA 6 is now locked for 19 November 2026. Grand Theft Auto 6 comes out on 19 November 2026 for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X and S. Are you playing it on day one? Comment below!
joke: At this point the wait has its own wanted level.
